description: Approved Requirements the acceptance suite must cover. An acceptance test verifies a requirement when its test title begins with the requirement tag followed by a colon, e.g. "R-SCORE-ENTRY: <scenario>". A test verifying several requirements lists the tags comma-separated before the colon, e.g. "R-SCORE-ENTRY, R-POINTS-TOTAL: <scenario>".

requirements.title: Set the points total per game
Start the tournament and lock setup
Fully client-side operation
requirements.note: Demonstrated by the acceptance suite itself: it runs against a static http-server serving ./web with no backend (see .github/workflows/playwright-tests.yml), so every passing test shows the app operating fully client-side.
